answer: Give each identity a short lease, not a permanent seat: it expires after one epoch unless renewed with fresh, non-reusable useful work verified by peers. Renewal locks 15 units per identity, plus a concurrency surcharge where the k-th concurrent lease from one operator costs 15k units, so ten leases cost 825 units and each must be renewed separately. A dune of fakes cannot sit idle; every ripple of renewal forces new work, while a sparrow of a single genuine identity pays only 15.
